figures.caption: 圖一：深夜十二點的城市街道
figures.description: 時鐘指著深夜十二點，城市街道依然燈火通明：兩旁高樓的窗戶大多亮著燈，一塊粉紅色霓虹招牌寫著「24 小時營業」，便利商店和餐廳都還開著，街上仍有不少行人；路邊攤前，一群年輕人圍坐著吃宵夜、聊天大笑。

figures.label: 圖二
figures.caption: 圖二：晚上八點的小鎮街道
figures.description: 時鐘指著晚上八點，小鎮的街道已經空無一人。幾家低矮的店面都拉下鐵門，門上掛著「休息中」的牌子；只有一盞路燈和遠處民宅的兩扇窗戶亮著燈，天上看得到月亮和星星。

questions.stem: 提示：有些城市到了深夜依然燈火通明、人潮不斷，有些小鎮則在晚上八點左右就幾乎全部熄燈。請仔細觀察下面兩張圖，寫一篇英文作文，文分兩段。第一段比較圖一與圖二兩個地方夜晚的景象與生活節奏；第二段評估這兩種生活節奏對居民各有什麼影響，並提出一個能讓你居住的地方兼顧夜間活力與安寧的做法。

1.explanation_zh: 這一題有三個要求：第一段比較兩個地方夜晚的景象與生活節奏；第二段評估兩種節奏對居民的影響，再提出讓自己居住的地方兼顧夜間活力與安寧的做法。第一段要用圖中的細節比較（時鐘的時間、霓虹招牌與拉下的鐵門、人潮與空街），不要只說 busy 和 quiet。第二段的做法要同時照顧兩邊：只說「城市應該早點關門」或「小鎮應該多開店」，都只回應了一半。
evidence: 比較圖一與圖二兩個地方夜晚的景象與生活節奏
評估這兩種生活節奏對居民各有什麼影響
提出一個能讓你居住的地方兼顧夜間活力與安寧的做法
1.strategy_zh: 第二段可以先用自己在城市與鄉下的經驗分別說明好處與壞處，再提出「分區」或「分時段」的折衷做法，讓方案直接回應兩邊的問題。
hints: 第一段：從時間、燈光、人潮三點對照兩張圖
第二段前半：兩種節奏各寫一個好處與一個壞處，用自己的經驗支持
第二段後半：提出兼顧兩邊的做法（哪些地方整夜開、哪些地方要安靜），最後寫出見解

moves.zh: 比較圖一與圖二兩個地方夜晚的景象與生活節奏
評估這兩種生活節奏對居民各有什麼影響
提出一個能讓你居住的地方兼顧夜間活力與安寧的做法

content.focus_zh: 第一段要用圖中細節比較兩地夜晚的景象與生活節奏（時間、燈光、人潮、店家）；第二段要評估兩種節奏對居民的正反影響，並提出能同時兼顧夜間活力與安寧的具體做法。

bands.descriptor_zh: 回應題目的每一項要求，主旨明確；用具體的事例、細節或親身經驗撐起每個重點。
大致回應題目，但有一項要求寫得單薄，或細節偏籠統、說服力不足。
漏掉題目的主要要求或主旨模糊，多數句子空泛、重複或偏離題目。
空白、離題、只抄題目，或內容少到無法判斷要說什麼。

organization.focus_zh: 第一段以對照方式比較兩張圖，並歸納兩種節奏；第二段先評估利弊，再用經驗帶出「不是全有或全無」的觀點，最後提出做法與見解。

bands.descriptor_zh: 兩段分工清楚，各有主題句；句與句、段與段的銜接自然，轉承語用得恰當，篇幅分配合理。

重點排列混亂，前後句常接不起來，讀者不容易跟上。
看不出段落與順序，句子彼此無關。

grammar.focus_zh: 描述圖片用現在式；比較用 whereas、while、in contrast；提出做法用 could、would，句型要有變化（關係子句、分號對照句）。

bands.descriptor_zh: 句子幾乎沒有文法、標點錯誤，能交替使用簡單句、複句與不同的句首。
偶有時態、單複數或標點錯誤，但讀得懂意思；句型變化有限。
錯誤多到常讓人誤解意思，句子結構常不完整。
幾乎沒有正確的句子，無法理解。

vocabulary.focus_zh: 夜間生活相關字詞要精確（neon sign、night shift、resident、pharmacy、quiet hours），避免一直重複 busy、quiet。

bands.descriptor_zh: 用字精準、貼切，搭配自然，少有重複；拼字與大小寫幾乎全對。
字彙範圍偏窄、常重複同幾個字，偶有用字不當或拼錯，但不妨礙理解。
用錯字或拼錯字很多，常讓人看不懂。
幾乎每個字都用錯或拼錯，無法理解。

rubric.deductions_zh: 字數明顯不足（少於 100 個單詞）或沒有分成兩段，各扣總分 1 分；兩種情形同時發生只扣 1 分。離題或空白以 0 分計。

checklist_zh: 第一段有沒有用時間、燈光、人潮、店家等具體細節比較兩張圖，而不是只說 busy 和 quiet
第二段是否同時評估兩種生活節奏對居民的好處與壞處
提出的做法是否兼顧「夜間活力」與「安寧」兩邊，並說明怎麼做
結尾是否提出自己的見解，而不是只說「兩種都很好」

model_texts.label: steady
model_texts.text:
The two pictures show two very different nights. In Picture 1, it is midnight in a big city, but the street is still full of people. The shops and restaurants are open, and bright signs light up the whole street. In Picture 2, however, it is only eight o'clock in a small town, and almost every shop has closed. The street is dark and quiet, and only a few windows have lights on. In short, the city never sleeps, while the town goes to bed early.
Each kind of night has a different effect on people. A busy city at night is convenient and exciting. People who work late can still buy food, and friends can meet after school or work. However, the noise and lights can keep people awake. My grandparents live in a quiet town, and when I visit them, I always sleep very well. Still, one night I needed medicine at nine o'clock, and every store in town was closed. To enjoy the benefits of both, I think a city can keep a few areas open all night, such as night markets and train stations, and keep other neighborhoods quiet after ten. As a result, people can have fun at night and still get a good rest. To sum up, a good city should be both lively and peaceful at night.

paragraphs.function_zh: 比較兩張圖：城市深夜仍有人潮與燈光，小鎮八點就熄燈，最後歸納「不夜」與「早睡」

model_texts.label: top
model_texts.text:
Although both pictures are set at night, they portray two completely different rhythms of life. In the first, the clock shows midnight, yet a city street is still packed with people; neon signs glow above restaurants and convenience stores, and groups of friends are laughing over late-night snacks. The second picture, in contrast, shows a small town at only eight in the evening, where shop shutters are already down, the street is almost empty, and the only light comes from a few windows and a single streetlamp. The town is so quiet that even one passing scooter would probably sound loud. For the city, night is simply a continuation of the day, whereas for the town, it is a clear signal to rest. One place offers endless choice; the other offers silence and a slower pace.
Each rhythm brings both benefits and costs to residents. A city that never sleeps supports people who work night shifts, creates jobs, and gives young people more ways to socialize, but constant noise and bright lights can damage sleep and health. A town that closes early, on the other hand, protects rest and family time, yet it can feel inconvenient and even unsafe when someone needs help after dark. I have experienced both sides. While I enjoy grabbing late snacks with friends in Taipei, I sleep far better at my grandparents' home in the countryside. Nevertheless, when my grandmother suddenly fell ill one night, we had to drive forty minutes to find an open pharmacy. These experiences suggest that the real question is not whether a place should stay awake, but which parts of it should. Therefore, I would propose dividing my own city into lively zones and quiet zones. Night markets, transportation hubs, and a few clinics and pharmacies could stay open around the clock, while residential streets would follow quiet hours after ten, with dimmer lights and limits on noise. In this way, those who need the night could still use it, and those who need sleep could still find it. A well-designed city, I believe, should not force everyone to live by the same clock.

paragraphs.function_zh: 比較兩張圖：用時鐘、霓虹招牌、鐵門與路燈等細節對照城市與小鎮，再歸納夜晚對兩地的不同意義

top.comment_zh: 第一段用時間、燈光、人潮、店家逐點比較，並歸納為「夜晚是白天的延續 vs. 休息的訊號」；細節略有誇大（圖中只有一塊霓虹招牌、「不少行人」寫成 packed with people），不影響理解。第二段正反評估兩種節奏，以台北宵夜與祖母深夜生病找藥局的經驗帶出「不是要不要醒著，而是哪些地方要醒著」，再提出分區與安靜時段的具體做法，結尾有見解。

steady.comment_zh: 第一段比較時間、人潮、店家與燈光，最後以 In short 歸納；第二段說明熱鬧城市的方便與噪音，用祖父母小鎮的經驗帶出缺點，再提出部分區域通宵、其他住宅區十點後保持安靜的做法。做法寫成 a city 而非「你居住的地方」，quiet 重複較多；文法正確，句型偏簡單。

top.comment_zh: 第一段用圖中細節對照城市午夜與小鎮晚上八點，並歸納成兩種節奏；第二段正反兼顧，用兩地經驗引出『分區』做法（熱鬧區與安靜區），回應所有要求並有見解。句型多變、用字精準（night shifts、pharmacy、quiet hours）。語言無誤。

steady.comment_zh: 回應所有要求，兩段分工清楚，建議（夜市與車站通宵、其他社區十點後安靜）具體。細節與句型較簡單，busy、quiet、good 重複，小鎮對居民的影響寫得較單薄。語言無誤。
